correctness.rationale: Conditional on R=r the r positive one-run lengths form a uniform composition of a because the number of placements of b zeros is C(b+1,r), independent of the lengths. Counting singleton parts yields C(r,s)C(a−r−1,r−s−1)/C(a−1,r−1) for r<a and a point mass at r=a. The explicit adjacent row likelihood ratio (r+1)(d−u)(d−u−1)/[(u+1)u(d−1)] increases with s, and feasible supports shift right; this verifies all joint TP2 minors including zero entries. Marked-composition expectation r(r−1)/(a−1), factorial moments E[(R)_t]=(a)_t(b+1)_t/(a+b)_t for t<=3 and Vandermonde produce covariance 2ab²(a−1)(b+1)/[(a+b)²(a+b−1)(a+b−2)]. Independent enumeration checked exact joint counts for fixed-content words through small a,b, 3,738 exact minors and 35 exact covariance cases; formulas handle degenerate boundaries explicitly.
